app-caches.library-caches.name: Caches of your apps
app-caches.library-caches.what: Files your installed apps keep in your Library's Caches folder to open and work faster, one folder per app.
app-caches.library-caches.made-by: The apps themselves; each item names its app.
app-caches.library-caches.if-removed: What is inside the folder goes to the Trash and the folder stays. Your documents and the app's settings are kept elsewhere and stay.
app-caches.library-caches.comes-back: Yes, the app makes it again as it needs it. Its next start may be slower, and an app that kept music, videos or maps for offline use downloads them again.
app-caches.browsers.name: Browser caches
app-caches.browsers.what: Copies of web pages, scripts and pictures your browsers keep so sites open faster, kept for each browser profile.
app-caches.browsers.made-by: The browsers themselves; each item names its browser, its profile and the cache folder.
app-caches.browsers.if-removed: What is inside the folder goes to the Trash and the folder stays. Your history, bookmarks, passwords, cookies and open tabs are kept elsewhere and stay.
app-caches.browsers.comes-back: Yes, the browser fills it again as you browse. Sites may open a little slower the first time, and pictures and videos download again.
app-caches.web-engine.name: Caches of web-based apps
app-caches.web-engine.what: Files that apps built with web technology, such as chat apps and code editors, keep in their own support folder to draw their windows and run faster.
app-caches.web-engine.made-by: The apps themselves; each item names its app and the cache folder.
app-caches.web-engine.if-removed: What is inside the folder goes to the Trash and the folder stays. Your messages, files, settings and sign-ins are kept elsewhere in the app's folder and stay.
app-caches.web-engine.comes-back: Yes, the app makes it again as it needs it. Its next start may be slower.
app-caches.enabled.label: Caches of your apps
app-caches.enabled.description: Finds the caches your installed apps keep for themselves, while each app is closed. The folders are emptied into the Trash; the apps make them again.
app-caches.reason: {app} keeps {size} here to work faster. It is closed now and makes the cache again when it needs it.
app-caches.left-out.special: It holds a connection a running program may be using, so it is kept.
app-caches.left-out.not-yours: Some of it belongs to the system or another user, or is locked, often after a command run with sudo. Removing it needs an administrator.
app-caches.left-out.no-system: Fresher could not list your open apps, so it keeps this. Scan again.
app-caches.left-out.app-open: This app, or a part of it, is open and may be using its cache. Quit it and scan again.
